register.labelZh: DROP 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: DROP 片語動詞可以自然地表達順道探訪某人、為對方帶來物品,或把物品送到某處。；drop back 可以描述名次下降;drop behind 可以表示進度落後;drop out 則表示在完成前中途退出。；drop off 可以自然地表示睡着;drop away 則可以描述地面或海床突然向下傾斜。；drop somebody in it 可以清楚表示某人的說話或行為令另一個人惹上麻煩。
register.summaryEn: DROP expressions let you talk naturally about visiting someone briefly, bringing them something or leaving an item at a place. Drop back describes moving to a lower place in a race or ranking. Drop behind describes making less progress, while drop out means leaving before the end. Drop off is a natural way to describe falling asleep. Drop away can describe land or a seabed that suddenly becomes much lower. Drop somebody in it clearly shows that one person’s words or actions have caused trouble for someone else.
